records.text: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar. He said, “Strike the atonement cover, and the foregates will shake; cut through the heads of all. I will kill their survivors with a sword. No one fleeing from among them will escape, and no one seeking safety will be saved.
and flight will perish from the runner, the mighty one will certainly not maintain his strength, and the fighter will certainly not save his life,
and the archer will certainly not stand, the swift of foot will certainly not be saved, nor will the horseman save his life,

triples.relationship: same-book warning that attempted escape cannot save
triples.rationale: Amos 9 says no fleeing person will escape and no one seeking safety will be saved. Chapter 2 likewise denies safety to the runner, fighter, archer and horseman. The later vision renews the warning that attempted escape will fail; chapter 2 explicitly names military ability.
